name: mitosis-probe-lit
description: Throwaway fitness probe: Mitosis Lit target for p-divider. Not wired into the monorepo build. Install with --workspaces=false.

scripts.build:crest: mitosis build && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Crest.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Crest.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-crest.bundle.js
scripts.build:wordmark: mitosis build && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Wordmark.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Wordmark.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-wordmark.bundle.js
scripts.build:flag: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Flag.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Flag.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-flag.bundle.js
scripts.build:model-signature: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-model-signature-fragment.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/ModelSignature.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/ModelSignature.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-model-signature.bundle.js
scripts.build:icon: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-model-signature-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-icon-fragment.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Icon.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Icon.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-icon.bundle.js
scripts.build:heading: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-model-signature-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-icon-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-heading-whitespace.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Heading.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Heading.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-heading.bundle.js
scripts.build:text: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-model-signature-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-icon-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-heading-whitespace.mjs && node harness/strip-text-whitespace.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Text.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && esbuild output/lit/src/Text.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-text.bundle.js
scripts.build:display: mitosis build && node harness/strip-flag-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-model-signature-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-icon-fragment.mjs && node harness/strip-heading-whitespace.mjs && node harness/strip-text-whitespace.mjs && node harness/strip-display-whitespace.mjs && if rg -q my-fragment output/lit/src/Display.ts; then echo 'my-fragment leaked'; exit 1; fi && ../../node_modules/.bin/esbuild output/lit/src/Display.ts --bundle --format=iife --tsconfig=tsconfig.json --alias:lit/decorators=lit/decorators.js --outfile=harness/lit-display.bundle.js
scripts.verify:heading: node harness/verify-heading.mjs
scripts.pixel-diff:heading: node harness/pixel-diff-heading.mjs
